# Fadlan Achmad Frizal — Portfolio & Professional Services

> Official portfolio and services registry of Fadlan Achmad Frizal, a Fullstack Developer & DevOps Enthusiast based in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.

## Summary
Fadlan is a graduate in Software Engineering (RPL) from [SMK Telkom Shandy Putra Jakarta](https://smktelkom-jkt.sch.id/) and a student of Information Systems at [Universitas Esa Unggul](https://www.esaunggul.ac.id/). He specializes in web development (React, Laravel), Linux VPS configuration, Docker containerization, CI/CD automation, and network monitoring (NOC).

## Services
Fadlan offers professional web development and systems engineering services via [WhatsApp Contact](https://wa.me/6281584350420):
- **Landing Page**: Modern, high-converting landing pages for businesses.
- **Fullstack Web Application**: Interactive web applications built with React/Vite and Laravel API with databases.
- **Company Profile / Portfolio**: Custom profile websites for personal branding or business presentation.
- **VPS Setup & DevOps Deployment**: Configuring Linux VPS (Ubuntu), Docker containers, Nginx reverse proxy, and Cloudflare Tunnel integration.

## Projects
- [Acentra Service](https://acentraservice.com): Modern service business landing page. Features a cost calculator, custom static SSR prerender for SEO, and auto-deployment via Docker, Nginx, and Cloudflare Tunnel on Linux VPS.
- [Wisma 46 Space (Premium Office Booking)](https://w46space.nexvol.xyz/): Platform for renting premium office spaces in Wisma 46 Jakarta. Built with Laravel 11 API, React.js, Midtrans payment gateway, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, Docker containerization, and Grafana monitoring.
- [AutoPro Car Service](https://autopro.nexvol.xyz/): Mobile-first landing page for automotive workshop. WhatsApp booking integration, deployed via Docker, Nginx, and Cloudflare.
- [Five Restaurant Franchise Platform](https://fiverestaurant.nexvol.xyz/): Multi-page franchise platform built with OOP PHP Native, MySQL 8.0, GitHub Actions pipeline, and Docker staging setup.
